description: React component for rendering and managing the sidebar channel list in Mattermost, including drag-and-drop, unread indicators, and keyboard navigation.

classes.name: SidebarList
classes.description: React component managing the sidebar channel list with drag-and-drop, unread indicators, and keyboard navigation.

methods.name: getDisplayedChannelIds
methods.description: Returns array of IDs of currently displayed channels.

methods.name: getDisplayedStaticPageIds
methods.description: Returns array of IDs of static pages displayed.

methods.name: setChannelRef
methods.description: Sets or deletes a reference to a channel DOM element.

methods.name: getFirstUnreadChannelFromChannelIdArray
methods.description: Finds the first unread channel ID from a list of channel IDs.

methods.name: handleScrollAnimationUpdate
methods.description: Updates scrollbar position during scroll animation.

methods.name: scrollToFirstUnreadChannel
methods.description: Scrolls to the first unread channel.

methods.name: scrollToLastUnreadChannel
methods.description: Scrolls to the last unread channel.

methods.name: scrollToChannel
methods.description: Scrolls to a specific channel by ID.

methods.name: scrollToPosition
methods.description: Animates scrolling to a specific position.

methods.name: updateUnreadIndicators
methods.description: Updates visibility of unread indicators based on scroll position.

methods.name: getFirstUnreadChannel
methods.description: Gets the first unread channel ID.

methods.name: getLastUnreadChannel
methods.description: Gets the last unread channel ID.

methods.name: navigateById
methods.description: Navigates to a channel or static page by ID.

methods.name: navigateChannelShortcut
methods.description: Handles keyboard shortcuts for navigating channels.

methods.name: navigateUnreadChannelShortcut
methods.description: Handles keyboard shortcuts for navigating unread channels.

methods.name: renderCategory
methods.description: Renders a sidebar category component.

methods.name: onScroll
methods.description: Handles scroll events with debounce.

methods.name: onTransitionEnd
methods.description: Handles end of CSS transition with debounce.

methods.name: onBeforeCapture
methods.description: Prepares state before drag capture.

methods.name: onBeforeDragStart
methods.description: Sets state before drag starts.

methods.name: onDragStart
methods.description: Handles drag start event.

methods.name: onDragEnd
methods.description: Handles drag end event, updating state and moving items.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the sidebar list component with unread indicators and drag-and-drop context.
